**Maps on the same server.** Gaia and Cumania IV can share a server, so the "Map" row now has an **Auto** mode (default): the mod looks up which dynmap world you are in and shows that map's territories, cities and wars, switching by itself when you change world. Click the row to pick Gaia or Cumania IV by hand, and once more to go back to Auto. (For Minecraft 26.1.x, 26.2 and 26.3.)
